purpose: Selective Phase-2 shared-store prerequisites for the manual market/PAPER runtime
dependency_notes: This manifest contains only the Phase-2 files required by the manual market/PAPER runtime.
It intentionally excludes cli.py, composition automation, detector scripts, systemd units, and the Rust executor main binary.
The state-reader prerequisite remains on its dedicated guarded patch path.
This manifest authorizes preflight only. It does not authorize apply, service changes, timer enablement, detector cursor movement, signing/submission, or real capital.
